scope: Muntahā al-madārik, four-foundation introduction + concluding preface only

units.arabic_exact: الأصل الأول في ذكر رتب الذات وتعيّن الأسماء منها والصفات وذكر كيفية انتشاء الفروع من تلك الأسماء والصفات من أصولها مع تعرّض لشرح الأسماء التسعة والتسعين ، وذكر انتشاء باقي الأسماء منها دقيقها وجليلها
units.english_review: First foundation. On the ranks of the Essence, the determination of the names and attributes from it, how branches of the names and attributes arise from their roots, the ninety-nine names, and the arising of the other names from them, whether subtle or exalted.
units.scholarly_note: Authorial first-foundation heading, not an editorial title; two other foundations and the closing preface remain outside this first proof segment.

units.arabic_exact: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمنِ الرَّحِيمِ
units.english_review: In the name of God, the All-Merciful, the Ever-Merciful.
units.scholarly_note: Basmala is in the digital source, not a modern preface.

units.arabic_exact: نقل عن رسول اللّه صلّى اللّه عليه وسلّم أنه قال : « قال اللّه عزّ وجلّ : كنت كنزا مخفيّا فأحببت أن أعرف ، فخلقت الخلق لأعرف » « 1 » .
units.english_review: It is transmitted from the Messenger of God—may God bless him and grant him peace—that he reported God, mighty and exalted, as saying: 'I was a hidden treasure and loved to be known; so I created creatures that I might be known.'
units.scholarly_note: Farghānī attributes the hidden-treasure saying to the Prophet. This preserves his own framing but is not an authentication. Historical hadith criticism does not establish an isnād for the saying.

units.arabic_exact: اعلم أيّدك اللّه بالفهم الصحيح أنه قد كنى في هذا الحديث الإلهي عن كنه الغيب وإطلاق الذات الأقدس وباطن الهوية الأزلية بالكنز المخفي ،
units.english_review: Know—may God assist you with sound understanding—that in this divine saying 'hidden treasure' stands figuratively for the innermost reality of the Unseen, the non-delimitation of the most holy Essence, and the inward aspect of pre-eternal divine Identity.
units.scholarly_note: كنه, إطلاق and باطن are respectively inward reality, non-delimitation and inward aspect; avoid treating all three as undifferentiated 'hiddenness'.

units.arabic_exact: وذلك لملابسة أن الكنز عبارة عن عين مغيب مكنون وسرّ مخزون مشتمل على جواهر عظيمة الجدوى مرغوب فيها ما بين أنفس تصان ويضنّ ويستأثر بها وبين نفيس ، ربما يقع فيه التسامح والتبدّل خصوصا أو عموما ،
units.english_review: The image is used because a treasure is a concealed entity and safeguarded secret containing jewels of great worth. Some are so choice that their possessor guards and reserves them; others are precious but may be permitted to pass into exchange, whether privately or publicly.
units.scholarly_note: Preserve the scale of الأنفس versus النفيس; the 'exchange' motif is an analogy, not trade in divine realities.

units.arabic_exact: ومهما أريد إظهاره يعرض أولا عرضا مجملا بحيث يبين الكنز ويظهر لواجده في محله ، ثم يعرض ثانيا عرضا يميّز فيه بين الأنفس والنفيس ، وينقل منه عن محله لحكمة يراها الواجد من إظهار كماله الذي يتضمّن غناءه وإظهار التجمّل والجود ونحو ذلك ،
units.english_review: When the treasure is to be disclosed, it is displayed first collectively, so that it appears as a treasure to the finder in its place; next it is presented in a differentiated way, distinguishing the choicest from the precious, and some is moved from its place according to the wisdom of its finder, thereby displaying a perfection that includes wealth, beauty, and generosity.
units.scholarly_note: First collective exposure, then differentiated disclosure; do not replace succession of rank with temporal change in the Divine.

units.arabic_exact: وكذلك كنه الجناب الأقدس تعالى وتقدّس وله المثل الأعلى في السماوات والأرض وهو العزيز الحكيم ، بلا نسبة تشبيه وتشكيل وتمثيل إليه تعالى عن ذلك علوّا كبيرا ،
units.english_review: Likewise the innermost reality of the most holy divine Presence—sublime and sacred, and God has the supreme similitude in the heavens and earth; He is the Mighty, the Wise—is to be spoken of without likening Him to creatures, attributing a form to Him, or making any representation of Him.
units.scholarly_note: Literal language of المثل الأعلى and three explicit disavowals of comparison. These are authorial qualifications, not secondary editorial footnotes.

units.arabic_exact: فإنه الغيب المكنون والسرّ المصون الذي هو أبطن كل باطن ، وبطون المشتمل على جواهر أسماء الذات التي هي أنفس نفائس الأسماء التي منها ما يستأثر في مكنون الغيب عنده ،
units.english_review: For it is the guarded Unseen and preserved secret, more inward than every inwardness, and an inwardness comprising the jewels of the names of the Essence, the choicest of precious names.
units.scholarly_note: «وبطون المشتمل» is awkward in both digitized B2007 and photographed I1876 printed p5 (I1876-L01). 'An inwardness comprising' is a provisional construal, not a textual emendation.

units.arabic_exact: فلا يعلمها إلّا هو ومن ارتفعت بينونته ورفعت كينونته ممن هو أكمل جميع
units.english_review: Of these He reserves some in the hidden mystery with Him. None knows them save He, and one whose otherness and separate self-subsistence have been lifted away, among the most perfect of all ...
units.scholarly_note: Sentence continues on printed Beirut p19 with «الكمّل في عرض التعيّن والتجلّي الأول». The translation must not invent a completed syntactic ending before the page break.

units.arabic_exact: الكمّل في عرض التعيّن والتجلّي الأول ، لتحقيق الكمال الذاتي الأشرف المعني بقوله : « فأحببت أن أعرف » « 1 » ،
units.english_review: ... the perfected, within the breadth or scope of the first determination and first self-disclosure, for the realization of the noblest essential perfection signified by the words 'I loved to be known.'
units.scholarly_note: «في عرض» is retained as 'within the breadth/scope' rather than the earlier potentially misleading claim that perfected persons 'participate in the display'; syntax follows p18 without a new sentence.

units.arabic_exact: وهو المتضمّن أيضا نفائس درر أسماء الصفات التي يسمح بتعريفها لكل من يصلح لتشريفها من كل فرد متخلّق ، أو كامل متحقّق ،
units.english_review: It [the treasure] also contains the precious pearls of the names of the attributes. He allows them to be made known to each person suited to be honoured by that disclosure, whether one who has acquired their qualities or one fully realized in them.
units.scholarly_note: Preserve attribution of qualifying spiritual capacities, not a universal disclosure of all attributive names.

units.arabic_exact: والمحتوي أيضا على لآلىء أسماء الأفعال العامّ نفعها وأثرها ، والمستفيض حكمها وخبرها في جميع المراتب الكونيّة التي هي محال تمام الكمال الأسمائي والمطلب الغائبّ المعني بقوله : « فخلقت الخلق لأعرف » « 1 » .
units.english_review: It further includes the pearls of the names of acts, whose benefits and effects are general and whose judgments and reports flow into every cosmic rank. Those ranks are the loci in which the full perfection of the names and the ultimate object expressed by 'I created creatures that I might be known' are realized.
units.scholarly_note: Older I1876 PRINT p6 reads «المطلب الغائي» (ultimate/purposive goal), while modern digitized B2007 has «المطلب الغائبّ». The translation follows the photographed older PRINT provisionally; both readings preserved in apparatus, no manuscript claim.

units.arabic_exact: فقوله : « كنت » يخبر عن تعيّن مسبوق بالإطلاق ،
units.english_review: The words 'I was' tell of determination preceded by non-delimitation.
units.scholarly_note: «كنت» signals self-reference in a qualified determination, not a temporal change in the Essence.

units.arabic_exact: فإن مفهوم تاء المتكلّم عن نفسه يؤذن بتعيّنه في نفسه وظهوره حالة تكلّمه تعيّنا وظهورا .
units.english_review: For the first-person marker in the speaker's reference to himself implies determination within himself and appearance at the moment of self-reference.
units.scholarly_note: «حالة تكلّمه» is within the analogy of linguistic self-reference and must not assert a temporal divine utterance.

units.arabic_exact: أما قوله : « كنزا مخفيّا » ينبئ عن غيبه وإطلاقه بحيث لا يدخل تحت حكم معيّن يحكم عليه من حيث هذا الغيب والإطلاق ، ولا تحت إحاطة به علما من حيث تعيّناته أصلا ،
units.english_review: By contrast, 'a hidden treasure' indicates His unseen and non-delimited character: in this respect no specified judgment can be imposed upon Him, nor does knowledge derived from His determinations encompass Him.
units.scholarly_note: The names and modes of knowledge are not the same consideration as the non-delimited Essence.

units.arabic_exact: فإنّ مطلق الخفاء يحكم بذلك كلّه ،
units.english_review: For absolute hiddenness entails all of this.
units.scholarly_note: No metaphysical 'nothingness' is predicated of the Essence.

units.arabic_exact: وحيث كان الخفاء وقع خبرا « لكنت » عرف سبق الإطلاق والغيب على ذلك التعيّن ، ولكن سبقا رتبيّا لا زمانيّا ، فإنه صحّ أنه ليس عند اللّه صباح ولا مساء .
units.english_review: Because hiddenness is predicated of 'I was', non-delimitation and the Unseen are understood to precede that determination; but the priority is one of rank, not of time. For it is true that with God there is neither morning nor evening.
units.scholarly_note: «سبقا رتبيّا لا زمانيّا» is an explicit authorial constraint; preserve it exactly.

units.arabic_exact: وقوله : « فأحببت » يخبر عن ميل أصلي هو وصلة بين الخفاء والظهور المذكور ، وما ثمّ إلّا التعيّن الذي هو عين الوحدة ، فكان عينه .
units.english_review: The words 'and so I loved' announce an original inclination which joins the hiddenness and manifestation mentioned; since there is there nothing beyond the determination which is itself unity, this inclination is identical with it.
units.scholarly_note: «الميل الأصلي» is an inclination connecting hiddenness and disclosure; do not imply physical movement or acquired want.

units.arabic_exact: وقوله : « أن أعرف » يشير إلى ظهور ذلك الخافي ،
units.english_review: The phrase 'that I might be known' points to the disclosure of what was hidden.
units.scholarly_note: Do not translate this as created need for recognition.

units.arabic_exact: وقوله : « فخلقت الخلق لأعرف » يعرف أن تقدير المقدّرات علما ووجودا يعقب ذلك الميل ويترتّب على متعلّقه الذي هو الظهور الحاصل بذلك التعيّن ليتحقّق كمال ذلك الظهور مفصّلا متميّزا ويشمل حكمه وأثره المقدّر والمقدّر تعقّبا ذاتيّا لا زمانيّا ، بل عمليّا ووجوديّا أيضا بالنسبة إلى المقدّر العالم الأزلي وعلمه الذاتي والصفاتي الأبدي ، فإن علمه عين وجوده ، فافهم تقرّ بالكبريت الأحمر والكنز الأكبر إن شاء اللّه تعالى .
units.english_review: The phrase 'so I created creatures that I might be known' indicates that determinations, in knowledge and existence, follow that inclination and are ordered to its object, namely disclosure through that determination. This allows the perfection of manifestation to be realized distinctly and in detail and to extend its effects to determiner and determined, in a succession of essence or rank, not time—indeed in knowledge and existence with respect to the pre-eternal Knower and His essential and attributive knowledge, for His knowledge is His very existence. Understand, and God willing you will gain the red sulphur and the greatest treasure.
units.scholarly_note: Two observed textual controls: historical 1876 PRINT reads «علميّا ووجوديّا» for modern digital «عمليّا ووجوديّا» and supports 'in knowledge and existence'; the repeated unvowelled «المقدّر والمقدّر» admits active/passive grammatical construal (determiner/determined), which needs better source control. Neither is claimed as a medieval MS variant.

units.arabic_exact: ثم اعلم أن كنه الذات الأقدس وغيب الهوية والإطلاق والأزلية المندرج فيه حكم الأبدية لا يشهد ولا يفهم ولا يعلم ولا يدرك من حيث التعيّن أصلا ، ولا يدخل تحت حكم متعيّن البتّة .
units.english_review: Know further that the innermost reality of the most holy Essence, the Unseen of Identity, non-delimitation and pre-eternity—which contains within it the import of everlastingness—cannot be witnessed, conceived, known or apprehended with respect to determination; nor can any determined judgment apply to it whatever.
units.scholarly_note: «الإطلاق» means the lack of delimitation; this does not nullify possibility of qualified knowledge described next.

units.arabic_exact: نعم اللّهمّ إلا حكما سلبيّا بأنها لا تعلم ،
units.english_review: One can except only the negative judgment that it cannot be known.
units.scholarly_note: Only a negative judgment is asserted, not a positive comprehending cognition of Essence.

units.arabic_exact: وإنما توجه وتأتى هذا الحكم السلبي أيضا بأحد وجهين ؛ أحدهما : إخبار إلهي عن ذلك
units.english_review: Even that negative judgment is reached in one of two ways. The first is divine notification of that fact ...
units.scholarly_note: The first way is elaborated at the start of p20. Maintain page-break continuity, no editorial completion.

units.arabic_exact: بقوله تعالى : وَلا يُحِيطُونَ بِهِ عِلْماً [ طه : الآية 110 ] ، وبقوله : « كنت كنزا مخفيّا » ونحو ذلك .
units.english_review: ... in His saying: 'They do not encompass Him in knowledge' (Qurʾān 20:110), and in the words 'I was a hidden treasure', and similar expressions.
units.scholarly_note: The Qurʾānic reference is Q 20:110; the 'hidden treasure' saying's poor transmission must not be conflated with Qurʾānic authority.

units.arabic_exact: والوجه الثاني : انقطاع أكمل الإدراكات والعلوم وأوسع الشهودات والفهوم إليه واعترافه بالعجز والقصور والحيرة فيه ، وبأن ما وراء غاية مدركه ونهاية مشهده بحار يحار في تيّارها فهم كل غائص واقف ، ويتيه في تيه كنهها وغور أسرارها علم كل خائض عارف ، هي المقصد الأعلى والمطلب الأولى ؛
units.english_review: The second way is that the utmost reaches of apprehension, knowledge, witnessing and understanding fall short of Him and confess inability, limitation and bewilderment. Beyond the furthest reach of what they apprehend and witness lie seas whose currents bewilder even the understanding of a deep diver and trackless wastes whose depths and hidden secrets bewilder every knowledgeable seeker. These are the highest goal and the most worthy object of seeking.
units.scholarly_note: Rank of intellect/witnessing is a confessed limit; do not read author as simply denying all qualified experiential knowledge.

units.arabic_exact: كما نصّ صلّى اللّه تعالى عليه وسلم بقوله في مناجاته : « لا أحصى ثناء عليك » « 1 » ،
units.english_review: As the Prophet—may God bless him and grant him peace—said in intimate supplication: 'I cannot enumerate praise of You.'
units.scholarly_note: «لا أحصى ثناء عليك» is a transmitted prophetic supplication. Retain authorial quotation and separate authentication from translation.

units.arabic_exact: لا أبلغ كل ما فيك ،
units.english_review: That is: 'I cannot attain all that belongs to You.'
units.scholarly_note: «لا أبلغ كل ما فيك» is Farghānī's interpretative paraphrase, NOT a clause in the prophetic supplication.

units.arabic_exact: وبقوله أيضا في أثناء دعائه : « أو استأثرت به في مكنون الغيب عندك » « 2 » ،
units.english_review: And in another passage of his supplication: 'Or [a name] that You have reserved for Yourself in the concealed Unseen with You.'
units.scholarly_note: «أو استأثرت به في مكنون الغيب عندك» appears in the supplication concerning divine names; '[a name]' is a contextual English addition, not present as a new separate Arabic noun in this clause.

units.arabic_exact: وبقوله : « ربّ زدني فيك تحيّرا » « 3 » ، وأمثال ذلك .
units.english_review: And in the words 'My Lord, increase me in bewilderment concerning You', and similar sayings.
units.scholarly_note: «رب زدني فيك تحيّرا» is found in Farghānī's text but has been judged not an established prophetic hadith by hadith critics, e.g. Ibn Taymiyya in his discussion of the saying. The edition must distinguish authorial citation from authentication.

units.arabic_exact: ومهما علم أو شوهد أو أدرك شيء منها عند تجلّيها الظاهري أو الباطني أو الجمعي في السير الحبي وقرب النوافل ، وتقدم السلوك على الجذبة وسبق الفناء « 4 » على البقاء « 5 »
units.english_review: Whenever something of these hidden realities becomes known, witnessed or apprehended through their outward, inward, or comprehensive self-disclosure in the journey of love and proximity through supererogatory works, where discipline precedes attraction and annihilation precedes subsistence ...
units.scholarly_note: «السير الحبي وقرب النوافل» and 'discipline before attraction; annihilation before subsistence' mark one path in contrast to the following p21 beloved-path.

units.arabic_exact: حيث يكون ويظهر لدى الفتح أن الحقّ المتجلّي آلة لإدراك العبد
units.english_review: ... it becomes apparent at the opening that the self-disclosing Real is the means by which the servant to whom He discloses Himself apprehends ...
units.scholarly_note: Sentence continues at p21 «المتجلّي له من باب كنت سمعه وبصره». Do not read the p20 fragment as a complete claim independent of p21.

units.arabic_exact: المتجلّي له من باب « كنت سمعه وبصره ، فبي يسمع وبي يبصر » « 1 » ،
units.english_review: ... the servant to whom He discloses Himself, according to the words 'I became his hearing and sight; through Me he hears and through Me he sees.'
units.scholarly_note: Continuation of the same p20 sentence; preserve the servant's role in the n awāfil path (the Real as means of servant's apprehension).

units.arabic_exact: وفي السير المحبوبي وقرب الفرائض وتأخّر السلوك عن الجذبة وتقدم البقاء الأصلي على الفناء حيث يتبيّن أن العبد المتجلّى له آلة لإدراك الحق المتجلّي من باب « فإن اللّه تعالى قال على لسان عبده : سمع اللّه تعالى لمن حمده » « 2 » ،
units.english_review: In the journey of being beloved and nearness through obligatory acts, by contrast, disciplined wayfaring follows attraction, and original abiding precedes annihilation. Then it is disclosed that the servant who receives the self-disclosure is an instrument through which the self-disclosing Real apprehends, as in the words, 'God has said upon His servant's tongue: God hears the one who praises Him.'
units.scholarly_note: Do not collapse the n awāfil/obligatory-acts polarity: f arāʾiḍ path reverses which term is described as 'instrument'. The prayer formula سمع الله لمن حمده is an authorial analogy, not an argument for identity of worshipper and God.

units.arabic_exact: وعند انتهاء السيرين والجمع بين الحكمين ابتداء وانتهاء حيث يصح أن كل واحد منهما مدركا وآلة على التعاقب أو معا في حالة واحدة من باب وَما رَمَيْتَ إِذْ رَمَيْتَ وَلكِنَّ اللَّهَ رَمى [ الأنفال : الآية 17 ] ،
units.english_review: When the two journeys end and their two judgments are united from beginning to end, each [the Real and the servant] may be apprehender or instrument, alternately or simultaneously in a single state, as in the Qur'ānic words 'You did not throw when you threw, but God threw' (8:17).
units.scholarly_note: Q 8:17 anchors a simultaneous/alternating two-sided attribution, neither sheer monism nor autonomous causation.

units.arabic_exact: فعلى كل حال يكون ذلك العلم والشهود والتجلّي والإدراك من حيث تعينه ومشيئته وعلمه المقدّس بذاته الأقدس تعالى وتقدّس من حيث واحديتها ، لا من حيث إطلاقها وأحديتها ،
units.english_review: In any case, knowledge, witnessing, self-disclosure and apprehension of this kind pertain to His determination, His will, and His holy knowledge of His most holy Essence, under the consideration of oneness (wāḥidiyya), not under that of non-delimitation and unicity (aḥadiyya).
units.scholarly_note: Important exact B2007 qualifier «من حيث واحديتها» independently corroborated in I1876 p7; distinguish Essence's aḥadiyya from determinate wāḥidiyya.

units.arabic_exact: فإن إدراكه وشهوده من حيث تعيّنه وعلمه غير ممنوع ، بل موكول إلى مشيئته تعالى وتقدّس كما قال عزّ من قائل : وَلا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلَّا بِما شاءَ [ البقرة : الآية 255 ] ،
units.english_review: His apprehension and witnessing in respect of determination and knowledge are not prohibited; rather they are dependent upon His will, as in His words: 'They encompass nothing of His knowledge except what He wills' (Qurʾān 2:255).
units.scholarly_note: Author explicitly makes knowledge of the qualified determination possible by divine permission. Do not overgeneralize essential unknowability.

units.arabic_exact: ثم إن وحدته التي انتشئت منها الأحديّة « 3 » والواحدية هي عين ذاته لا صفة زائدة ولا نعت زائد عليها ،
units.english_review: His unity, from which unicity (aḥadiyya) and oneness (wāḥidiyya) arise, is identical with His Essence, neither an added attribute nor a further qualification.
units.scholarly_note: These are two considerations of one essential unity, not two divine substances.

units.arabic_exact: لكن للوحدة اعتباران أصليّان أوليّان ،
units.english_review: But unity admits two primordial and primary considerations.
units.scholarly_note: The grammatical pair iʿtibārāt is philosophical 'considerations', not ontologically independent properties.

units.arabic_exact: أحدهما : سقوط الاعتبارات عنها بالكلية ، وسمّي الذات أحدا بهذا الاعتبار ومتعلقة بطون الذات وإطلاقها وأزليّتها ،
units.english_review: In the first, all considerations whatsoever fall away from it. Under this consideration the Essence is called aḥad (One-in-unicity); this consideration concerns the inwardness, non-delimitation and pre-eternity of the Essence.
units.scholarly_note: «سقوط الاعتبارات» indicates the absence of delimiting considerations at the level named aḥad.

units.arabic_exact: وعلى هذا يكون نسبة الاسم الأحد إلى السلب أحقّ من نسبته إلى الثبوت والإيجاب .
units.english_review: In this respect the name aḥad is more properly referred to negation than to positive affirmation.
units.scholarly_note: Negation is predicated of the designation aḥad, not of divine actuality itself.

units.arabic_exact: والاعتبار الثاني : ثبوت الاعتبارات الغير المتناهية لها مع اندراجها فيها في أول رتبة الذات ،
units.english_review: The second consideration is that infinitely many considerations are established for it, though they remain included within it at the first rank of the Essence.
units.scholarly_note: «ثبوت» is establishment of relations in unity, not independent external realization.

units.arabic_exact: وتحقّق أكثر تفصيل تعيّناتها في ثاني الرتبة الآتي بيان كليهما عن قريب إن شاء اللّه تعالى ؛ كالنصفية والثلثية والربعية الثابتة والمندرجة في هذا الواحد المشهود ههنا ، التي ينتشىء منها الأعداد في المراتب الوجودية ، وينتشىء من تلك الاعتبارات أعيان الاثنين والثلاثة والأربعة فيها ،
units.english_review: The greater differentiation of their determinations becomes actual at the second rank, and both ranks will be explained soon, God willing. The analogy is with the relations of being a half, third or quarter, established in and included within the numerical one whose effects we observe: numbers arise through those relations in the orders of being, and with them the determinate twos, threes and fours.
units.scholarly_note: Keep analogy of number limited: the one is not divided into physical parts when it is half of two.

units.arabic_exact: كما يقال : الواحد نصف الاثنين ، وثلث الثلاثة ، وربع الأربعة وهلمّ جرّا .
units.english_review: As one says: one is half of two, a third of three, a quarter of four, and so on.
units.scholarly_note: These are examples of logical relations, not a claim that God is a numeral.

units.arabic_exact: والذات بهذا الاعتبار يسمّى واحدا اسما ثبوتيّا لا سلبيّا ،
units.english_review: Under this consideration the Essence is called wāḥid, a name of positive affirmation rather than negation.
units.scholarly_note: Positive title wāḥid is not coextensive with the negatively characterized aḥad.

units.arabic_exact: ولم تصح إضافة هذه الاعتبارات المذكورة إلى الاسم الأحد لا حقيقة ولا وضعا لغويّا ،
units.english_review: The considerations just described cannot be assigned to the name aḥad, neither in reality nor according to linguistic convention.
units.scholarly_note: Technical/linguistic limitation stated explicitly.

units.arabic_exact: فحقائق هذه
units.english_review: The realities of these ...
units.scholarly_note: Printed p21 ends mid-noun phrase and p22 begins «الاعتبارات»; do not invent a complete standalone sentence.

units.arabic_exact: الاعتبارات في أول رتبة الذات ثابتة للاسم الواحد الحقيقي ، ومندرجة فيه ثبوتا حقيقيّا واندراجا أصليّا ؛
units.english_review: ... considerations at the first rank of the Essence are established under the name of the truly One, and are truly established and originally contained in it.
units.scholarly_note: Continuation of p21 «فحقائق هذه»; no newly introduced subject.

units.arabic_exact: كما أن أمثلتها وصورها ثابتة لهذا الواحد المشهود أثره لنا ههنا ، ومندرجة فيه غير قادحة في الرتبتين في صرافة هذا الواحد ، ولا منافية لها ،
units.english_review: Just as the examples and images of these considerations are established and included within the numerical one whose effect we witness here, without, in either rank, impairing or contradicting the purity of that one.
units.scholarly_note: The analogy is logical relation-without-partition, not numerical identity of Essence with created number.

units.arabic_exact: ومتعلق هذا الاعتبار الواحدي ظهور الذات ووجودها وأبديّتها ؛ كما أن متعلق الاعتبار الأحدي بطونها وأزليّتها ،
units.english_review: What pertains to the consideration of wāḥidiyya is the Essence's manifestation, existence and everlastingness, just as what pertains to the consideration of aḥadiyya is its inwardness and pre-eternity.
units.scholarly_note: Pre-eternity (azaliyya) and everlastingness (abadiyya) are presented under different considerations, not two temporal segments of God.

units.arabic_exact: ولا مغايرة ولا غيرية بين هذين الاعتبارين ، ولا بين كل اعتبار واعتبار من اعتبارات الواحدية في أول رتبة الذات الآتي بيانه ؛
units.english_review: These two considerations are not different or other than one another; neither is any one consideration of oneness different from another at the first rank of the Essence, to be explained.
units.scholarly_note: Multiplicity of considerations is not multiplicity of essences.

units.arabic_exact: لأن المغايرة والغيرية من أحكام الكثرة والمنافاة الثابتة بينها وبين الوحدة ، ولا كثرة ثمة تنافي الوحدة ،
units.english_review: Otherness and difference are consequences of multiplicity and of its opposition to unity; no such multiplicity at that rank opposes unity.
units.scholarly_note: «المغايرة والغيرية» preserve distinguishable but related terms.

units.arabic_exact: بل تلك الوحدة هي المنشئة لكل وحدة وكثرة مفهومة ههنا متغايرة عندنا ، ولا مغايرة ولا غيرية ولا امتياز كما قلنا آنفا في أول رتبة الذات الأقدس ،
units.english_review: Rather, that unity is the source of every unity and multiplicity which appears mutually differentiated to our understanding. As stated, otherness, difference and differentiation do not obtain at the first rank of the most holy Essence.
units.scholarly_note: Earlier synthesis correctly denies opposition at rank one; this does not erase later degrees of differentiated realities.

units.arabic_exact: ولا يفهم ارتفاع هذه المغايرة في تلك الحضرة إلّا من ارتفع حالا ومقاما عن التقيّد بالمراتب المقيّدة بأحكام الكثرة والمقيّدة لأربابها بها ،
units.english_review: Only someone who has risen, in spiritual state and station, beyond restriction by ranks governed by multiplicity, which bind their possessors to those judgments, can understand how this otherness is absent in that Presence.
units.scholarly_note: Refers to transformation of the knower, not suspension of distinctions in ordinary law or empirical cognition.

units.arabic_exact: ولارتفاع حكم هذه المغايرة في الرتبة الأولى حكم بها بعض أكابر المحقّقين من أهل اللّه بأن الواحد الأحد اسم واحد مركّب ؛ كبعلبك ومعديكرب .
units.english_review: Because difference is suspended at this first rank, some great realized knowers among the people of God regard al-wāḥid al-aḥad as a single compound name, just as Baʿlabakk and Maʿdīkarib are compound proper names.
units.scholarly_note: Author supplies the actual compound-name examples Baʿlabakk and Maʿdīkarib; generic 'certain proper names' may be expanded in the reader without technical intrusion.

units.arabic_exact: ثم اعلم أن هذه الاعتبارات الثابتة للواحد ثمة ، والمندرجة فيه في أول رتبة الذات المحكوم عليها فيها بأنها عين الذات ، بحيث إن كل ما يضاف إلى الذات يضاف إلى كلّ واحد منها من الجمعية والاشتمال على الكلّ في هذه الرتبة الأولى بحسبها
units.english_review: Know further that those considerations established for the One and included within it at the first rank are there judged to be identical with the Essence. Accordingly, whatever is attributed to the Essence in respect of comprehensiveness and containing the whole is attributed to each of them at that rank.
units.scholarly_note: «محكوم عليها فيها بأنها عين الذات» is predication at a particular rank; avoid asserting independent eternal essences.

units.arabic_exact: نظرنا من حيث مظاهرها وصورها وآثارها إليها ألفينا بعضها كلّيات وأصولا أول بمثابة أجناس عالية هي مسمّى ألفاظ دالّة على حقائق أسماء الذات ومفهوماتها التي منها مفاتح الغيب ، والواحد الأحد وباطن اسم اللّه ، وباطن اسم الرحمن الرحيم ، ومفهوم جمع أسماء الضمائر ،
units.english_review: When we consider them with regard to their manifestations, forms and effects, we find some to be universals and first principles, comparable to the highest genera. They are what the expressions denoting the realities and intelligible contents of the essential names signify: among them the Keys of the Unseen, al-wāḥid al-aḥad, the inward aspect of the name Allāh, the inward aspects of al-Raḥmān and al-Raḥīm, and the collective sense of the pronominal names.
units.scholarly_note: Stage XXI selected excerpt CR002-023 already corrected the Arabic «نظرنا ... ألفينا» (we considered, we found). Continuous English should reflect the first-person authorial grammar too.

units.arabic_exact: ووجدنا بعض تلك الاعتبارات المندرجة في الواحدية من حيث النظر في مظاهرها وآثارها بمثابة أجناس تالية وأنواع مندرجة فيها وهلمّ جرّا إلى أشخاص هاوية إلى الدّركات الجزئية جدّا التي بها يحكم على الحضرة الأبدية بعدم التناهي كثرة وتعيّنات وتقيّدات ،
units.english_review: Others of these considerations included in oneness, viewed through their manifestations and effects, resemble subordinate genera and species contained within them, down to individual things descending to the most narrowly particular degrees. By these, the everlasting Presence is spoken of as having infinitely many determinations, multiplicities and delimitations.
units.scholarly_note: Particularization ends in very low ranks, not in metaphysically autonomous individuals.

units.arabic_exact: والكل ثابتة بصورها المعنوية في الرتبة الثانية بعضها بطريق التشخّص ، وبعضها بطريق الاندراج في الأصناف والأنواع .
units.english_review: All remain established in intelligible forms at the second rank: some through individuation and some through inclusion in species and kinds.
units.scholarly_note: Established intelligible forms are not identical with physical external existence.

units.arabic_exact: نعم ، وقد تعيّنت وانضبطت جملة منها في اللّوح المحفوظ ، وتصوّرت صورا وجودية روحانية فيه منتهيا ظهورها بانتهاء يوم القيامة مجملا ومفصّلا ،
units.english_review: Many have further been determined and registered in the Preserved Tablet, taking on spiritual existential forms there. Their manifestation, general and detailed, extends to the end of the Day of Resurrection.
units.scholarly_note: «نعم وقد» introduces a qualification; do not identify Preserved Tablet with the earlier first rank.

units.arabic_exact: ويتفصّل منه في المراتب الوجودية مجملا في العرش ومفصّلا في الكرسي دفعة واحدة ، ثم يتفصّل منهما في الأركان والسماوات على التعاقب إلى أنهى مراتب
units.english_review: They are differentiated from the Tablet in the existential degrees, collectively in the Throne and distinctly in the Footstool at once, and thereafter in successive stages in the elements and heavens, down to the furthest degrees ...
units.scholarly_note: Sentence runs through next printed page, «الكون مثالا وحسّا». Do not silently complete the cosmic descent here.

units.arabic_exact: الكون مثالا وحسّا ، وفي المواطن دنيا وبرزخا وآخرة ،
units.english_review: ... of cosmic existence in imaginal and sensible modes, and of the abodes of this world, the intermediate state, and the world to come.
units.scholarly_note: Completes p22's gradual cosmological descent; 'world' is not just physical/empirical reality.

units.arabic_exact: وينتهي إلى ههنا جميع الشهودات والإدراكات والمكاشفات الحاصلة للكمّل والأولياء فالأدنى منهم وما فيهم أدنى ، والأعلى في حكم هذا الانتهاء سواء ،
units.english_review: Here is the limit of all the acts of witnessing, apprehension and unveiling attained by the perfected and the friends of God, whether lowest or highest among them; in regard to reaching this limit, both are alike.
units.scholarly_note: «الأدنى ... والأعلى» are alike only in the asserted terminus of disclosed ranks, not in all attainable degrees.

units.arabic_exact: إلّا أنه ربما يكون في الحضرة الغيبية الأزليّة نحو هذه الكلّيات والجزئيّات أمور باطنة وأحوال مستورة لم تتعيّن بعد لا في الرتبة الثانية ولا في اللّوح المحفوظ ،
units.english_review: Yet in the pre-eternal unseen Presence there may be concealed matters and hidden states of this kind among the universals and particulars that have not yet been determined in the second rank or the Preserved Tablet.
units.scholarly_note: Preserve modal qualification «ربما» and the exact level at which determination has not occurred.

units.arabic_exact: فلم تعلم ولم يحكم بشيء منها إلّا بعد تعيّنها ووقوعها في المراتب الوجودية بالتدريج مع الآنات ،
units.english_review: These have not been known or judged until they become determined and occur gradually in the ranks of existence, moment after moment.
units.scholarly_note: The text literally says «فلم تعلم ولم يحكم ... إلا بعد تعينها»; do not rewrite away the apparent tension with classical accounts of divine omniscience. Distinguish determinate knowability at ranks from God's essential knowing in later analysis, not in translation.

units.arabic_exact: وهي أبطن بطون أحكام الغيب الذاتي المغلوب والمسبوق بالرحمة الذاتية ،
units.english_review: They belong to the innermost hiddenness of the rulings of the essential Unseen, over which the essential mercy predominates and has precedence.
units.scholarly_note: «الرحمة الذاتية» means essential mercy here; the apparent priority of divine mercy is not described as an event in time.

units.arabic_exact: فلهذا أوجبت الرهبة والخشية المشار إليها في قوله تعالى : قُلْ ما كُنْتُ بِدْعاً مِنَ الرُّسُلِ وَما أَدْرِي ما يُفْعَلُ بِي وَلا بِكُمْ [ الأحقاف : الآية 9 ] ،
units.english_review: This produces the fearful awe indicated by the Qurʾānic words: 'Say: I am no unprecedented messenger, and I do not know what will be done with me or with you' (Q 46:9).
units.scholarly_note: Q 46:9; do not replace 'I do not know' with theological paraphrase.

units.arabic_exact: ومن وجه أيضا يشير إليها قوله صلّى اللّه عليه وسلّم شفقا منها : « ليت ربّ محمد لم يخلق محمدا » « 1 » ،
units.english_review: One aspect of this is also, in his fearful concern, alluded to by the saying attributed to the Prophet: 'Would that the Lord of Muḥammad had not created Muḥammad.'
units.scholarly_note: Attribution of «ليت رب محمد ...» is Farghānī's, not a verified prophetic report. Authentication requires a separate sourced takhrīj.

units.arabic_exact: مع أنه كان من حيث ما تعيّن من حاله صلّى اللّه عليه وسلّم في الحضرة العلمية واللّوح المحفوظ على بصيرة من ربّه
units.english_review: Yet insofar as his state was determined in the Presence of knowledge and the Preserved Tablet, he was granted insight by his Lord.
units.scholarly_note: The Prophet's qualified insight is distinguished from absolute, unlimited foresight.

units.arabic_exact: حتى أنه كان يقول اعتمادا عليها ونظرا إليها : « آدم ومن دونه تحت لوائي يوم القيامة ولا فخر » « 2 » ، « ولو كان موسى حيّا لما وسعه إلّا اتّباعي » « 3 » ،
units.english_review: Hence, relying upon that determined state and considering it, he would say: 'Adam and those below him are under my banner on the Day of Resurrection, without boasting'; and 'If Moses were alive, he would have no course but to follow me.'
units.scholarly_note: Preserve exact wording as Farghānī quotes it; prophetic-hadith grading varies by report and isnād, and this clause is not independently authenticated here.

units.arabic_exact: وقوله : « أنا أول من يقرع باب الجنّة وأول من يفتح باب الشفاعة » « 4 » ونحو ذلك من الإشارات في أحاديث صحاح ،
units.english_review: And: 'I shall be the first to knock at the gate of Paradise and the first to open the gate of intercession', together with similar indications in reports that Farghānī describes as sound.
units.scholarly_note: The author says «أحاديث صحاح», which reports his assessment; avoid making an editor's blanket authentication.

units.arabic_exact: وعلى الحقيقة كثيرا ما يجرّه الدعاء والسؤال من الأمور والأحكام الغيبية إنما يكون من تلك الأمور والأحوال ،
units.english_review: In truth, many things drawn forth from unseen matters and judgments by prayer and supplication arise from those hidden matters and states.
units.scholarly_note: Supplication does not physically produce an eternal change in divine knowledge; preserve his contrast between unmanifest contingencies and established allotments.

units.arabic_exact: فإن ما عداها لا يتحصّل إلّا المكتوب الثابت المقسوم في الحضرة العلمية لا يزيد ولا ينقص ،
units.english_review: As for what lies outside them, nothing can come to be except what is written, established and allotted in the Presence of knowledge; this neither increases nor decreases.
units.scholarly_note: «لا يزيد ولا ينقص» explicitly qualifies this class of established allotments, not the entire prior class.

units.arabic_exact: ثم إنه قد عبّر بعض العلماء باللّه الواقفين على حضراته الكلية عن بعض اعتبارات الواحدية المندرجة فيها في الرتبة الأولى بالشؤون الذاتية ،
units.english_review: Some knowers of God who have stood in His universal Presences have called certain considerations of wāḥidiyya, included at the first rank, 'essential affairs' (shuʾūn dhātiyya).
units.scholarly_note: These terms are the author's reported technical terminology for certain relations, not independent hypostases.

units.arabic_exact: وهي التي تظهر في الرتبة الثانية وما تحتها من المراتب بصور الحقائق المتبوعة وبعض صفاتها التابعة التي لها الثبات ، نحو الحياة والعلم
units.english_review: At the second rank and below they appear as forms of leading realities and of certain stable subordinate attributes, such as life and knowledge.
units.scholarly_note: «الحقائق المتبوعة» are leading/primary realities; «الصفات التابعة» subordinate stable properties.

units.arabic_exact: وبصور أمور كائنة ثابتة نحو الذوات والجواهر ،
units.english_review: They also appear as forms of enduring existent things, such as essences and substances.
units.scholarly_note: Do not flatten ذوات and جواهر to the same English technical term without note.

units.arabic_exact: وصفة بقائها وثباتها اعتبارا لبعض
units.english_review: Also included are attributes of endurance and stability, in respect of certain ...
units.scholarly_note: Continuation p24 «معاني الشأن وهو الأمر»; retain the incomplete authorial phrase across page break. Earlier p23 draft prematurely completed 'some meanings of affair'.

units.arabic_exact: معاني الشأن وهو الأمر ،
units.english_review: ... of the meanings of *shaʾn*, namely 'affair' or 'matter'.
units.note: Completes p23 ending «وصفة بقائها وثباتها اعتبارا لبعض». Together: attributes of the subsistence and stability of some meanings of 'affair'. The p23–24 join is one authorial syntactic unit, not two unrelated entries.

units.arabic_exact: وعبّر بعضهم عن بعضها بالأحوال الذاتية ،
units.english_review: Some have designated certain of these 'essential states' (*aḥwāl dhātiyya*).
units.note: Some speakers are reported; Farghānī does not here make 'states' substantial hypostases.

units.arabic_exact: وهي التي تظهر حين تبدو متحوّلة من صورة إلى صورة معنوية أو حسّية ؛ كالقبض والبسط ، والرضا والغضب ، وجميع الأعراض التي لا تدوم ، وكالخواطر والصور والهيئات المثالية والحسّية دنيا وبرزخا وآخرة
units.english_review: These are displayed when they appear transformed from one intelligible or sensible form to another: contraction and expansion, satisfaction and anger, and all the accidents that do not endure; likewise thoughts, images and imaginal or sensible configurations in this world, the intermediate world and the hereafter.
units.note: «أعراض لا تدوم» explicitly names nonenduring accidents; avoid making the ontological transition a change of God's unconditioned Essence.

units.arabic_exact: تذكر تحوّل الحق تعالى وتقدّس من صورة لم يعرفها قوم في الآخرة إلى صورة يعرفونه بها ، كما ورد في الخبر الصحيح « 1 » ،
units.english_review: Recall the report deemed sound by Farghānī in which the Real—exalted and holy—is encountered in the Hereafter in a form that a group does not recognize, and then in a form by which they recognize Him.
units.note: Author says «الخبر الصحيح»; the hadith concerning divine recognition after resurrection should be analyzed as transmitted, without equating an imaginal form with God's Essence. Modern source footnote on this page is excluded.

units.arabic_exact: واللّه المرشد .
units.english_review: God is the One who guides.
units.note: Short authorial devotional phrase.

units.arabic_exact: فصل اعلم أن أوّل اعتبار وتعيّن تعيّن من الغيب هذه الوحدة التي انتشأت منها الأحدية والواحدية ،
units.english_review: **Chapter.** Know that the first consideration and determination to arise from the Unseen is this unity from which *aḥadiyya* and *wāḥidiyya* have arisen.
units.note: The printed authorial «فصل» initiates the chapter; not a modern editor's chapter title.

units.arabic_exact: فظلّت برزخا جامعا بينهما ؛
units.english_review: It is therefore an intermediary (*barzakh*) embracing them both,
units.note: The intermediary encompasses two *considerations* of one unity, not two independent principles.

units.arabic_exact: كحقيقة المحبة المنتشئة منها المحبّية والمحبوبية وكونها جامعة بينهما ورافعة بينهما موحّدة إياهما ،
units.english_review: like the reality of love, from which the states of being lover and beloved arise, while it unites them and removes what separates them.
units.note: «رافعـة بينهما» means removing the interval or division; the analogy of love is not a divine emotional need.

units.arabic_exact: أو قل هي بحكم اقتضاء الباطن الحقيقي المكنى « بكنت كنزا مخفيّا » « 2 » ، الظهور المعبّر عنه بأن أعرف
units.english_review: Or say: it follows from the true inwardness indicated by 'I was a hidden treasure' that there should be the manifestation signified by 'that I might be known'.
units.note: Preserve both allusive sayings as Farghānī's conceptual source. Priority is of rank, not chronological change.

units.arabic_exact: وهذا الاعتبار والتعيّن الأول الذي هو عين الذات بحكم البرزخية والجمعية المذكورة هو عين قابلية الذات لبطونها وغيبها وانتفاء الاعتبارات عنها وحكم أزليّتها ،
units.english_review: This first consideration and determination, identical with the Essence under the aforementioned intermediate and comprehensive aspect, is the Essence's very receptivity to its hiddenness, its Unseen, the exclusion of considerations from it and the judgment of its pre-eternity,
units.note: The language of receptivity is analogical and under an explicit consideration; do not posit physical passivity or addition to the divine Essence.

units.arabic_exact: ولظهورها أيضا وظهور ما تضمّنت من الاعتبارات المثبتة حكم أبديتها لنفسها إجمالا ، ثم تفصيلا ،
units.english_review: and likewise to its manifestation and that of the affirmative considerations it contains, entailing everlastingness for itself, first comprehensively and then distinctly.
units.note: The pair of inwardness/manifestation maps onto aḥadiyya/wāḥidiyya without collapsing the two.

units.arabic_exact: فكانت هذه القابلية أصل كل قابلية وفاعلية أيضا ،
units.english_review: This receptivity is the origin of every receptivity, and of every activity too.
units.note: «قابلية وفاعلية» here are reciprocal relational capacities, not created substances.

units.arabic_exact: فهي مع أنها عين الذات كانت كالمتحدثة مع نفسها في نفسها ، والمخبرة لها بما هي عليه من اقتضاء ظهورها وظهور اعتبارات واحديتها والكمال الذاتي
units.english_review: Though identical with the Essence, it is likened to an inward speaker speaking to itself within itself, informing itself of what it is through its demand for its own manifestation and the manifestation of its considerations of oneness, together with essential perfection—
units.note: «كالمتحدثة» is an explicit analogy: as if speaking within itself; this unit ends mid-phrase at the printed page boundary.

units.arabic_exact: والأسمائي المتعلّق بذلك الظهور
units.english_review: —and the name-related perfection attendant upon that manifestation,
units.note: Continuation of p24 authorial phrase «والكمال الذاتي»; do not start a new doctrine.

units.arabic_exact: حديثا وإخبارا نزيها بحرف نزيه وحداني هو عين الذات متضمّن جميع المعاني كلّياتها وجزئياتها ،
units.english_review: in a speaking and informing transcendent of ordinary articulation, by a transcendent, unitary 'letter' identical with the Essence and embracing all meanings, universal and particular,
units.note: «حرف نزيه وحداني» is the author's transcendent analogical term, not an ordinary printed letter or a physical sound. The full grammatical relation of «حديثا وإخبارا نزيها» remains interpretative.

units.arabic_exact: والألفاظ والكلم القولي والفعلي الدالّة عليها في سابع رتب أبطن .
units.english_review: and the expressions and words, spoken or enacted, that signify them at the seventh and most inward rank of speech.
units.note: «الكلم القولي والفعلي» are verbal and active words in Akbarian usage, not merely utterances.

units.arabic_exact: الكلام المشار إليه في قوله صلى اللّه عليه وسلم : « إن للقرآن ظهرا وبطنّا ، وفي بطنه بطن إلى سبعة أبطن » « 1 » ،
units.english_review: This is the speech alluded to in the saying attributed to the Prophet: 'The Qurʾān has an outward and an inward; within that inward an inward, down to seven inward depths.'
units.note: The saying of seven Qurʾānic inward depths is not authenticated merely by its presence here. The modern edition's footnote reportedly could not locate this exact wording.

units.arabic_exact: كما يتحدّث أحدنا في نفسه بلا واسطة حرف وصوت ظاهر ،
units.english_review: An analogy is our speaking inwardly to ourselves without a manifest letter or audible sound.
units.note: «كما» marks the human inward-speaking analogy, not physiological speech attributed to God.

units.arabic_exact: وكان في تلك القابلية أيضا قابلية ميل الذات بالسماع والإصغاء إلى ذلك الحديث هي أثر تلك المحبّة في الحقيقة ،
units.english_review: In this same receptivity there is the Essence's receptivity to inclination through hearing and attentive listening to that inward speech; this inclination is, in reality, an effect of original love.
units.note: «قابلية» and «ميل الذات» in this context are rank-relative language; do not imply a need or acquired psychological disposition in the absolute Essence.

units.arabic_exact: فمالت بالسماع في سابع أبطن الميل بالسماع والإصغاء ،
units.english_review: So it inclined to listening at the seventh and most inward rank of inclination, hearing and attentiveness.
units.note: Seventh depth introduced before the subsequent human seven-depth exposition.

units.arabic_exact: وفي تلك القابلية أيضا قابلية ملاحظة الذات نور جمالها الذي هو عين واحديتها وظهورها وظهور اعتباراتها وملاحظة الكمال المتعلق بذلك بحسب ذلك الميل والسماع والإصغاء ،
units.english_review: In the same receptivity is the capacity to behold the light of its beauty, which is identical with its oneness, its manifestation and the manifestation of its considerations, and to attend to the perfection related to this manifestation in accordance with the inclination and hearing.
units.note: «نور جمالها» is its own beauty; sight here is contemplative, not retinal.

units.arabic_exact: فلاحظ في سابع رتب أبطن الملاحظة ،
units.english_review: Its contemplation thus occurred in the seventh and most inward rank of contemplation.
units.note: Repetition of the seventh inward rank is authorial.

units.arabic_exact: وفيها أيضا قابلية التأثر بذلك الحديث ليميط خمار غلبة حكم جلال الغيب والبطون عن الجمال والظهور المكني عن تلك الإماطة بتغليب الرحمة وسبقها على أنها غايات حكم الغضب عارجا لا نازلا وأبطنها الذي هو اللاظهور المتضمّن معنى الردى والعدم ،
units.english_review: It also admits an influence from this inward speech, removing the veil whereby the majesty of the Unseen and inwardness predominates over beauty and manifestation. Farghānī calls that removal the predominance and priority of mercy over the outermost reach of the judgment of anger, understood as ascending, not descending, and over its deepest aspect—nonmanifestation, associated with destruction and absence.
units.note: The source says «على أنها غايات حكم الغضب عارجا لا نازلا»; the English is deliberately provisional for this difficult syntax. It is a short photographed 1876 print agreement (I1876-L08), but not a manuscript-resolved reading.

units.arabic_exact: فإن الظهور واللاظهور كان في حكم اقتضاء هذه القابلية الأولية على السواء ،
units.english_review: For appearance and nonappearance were equally possible under the exigency of this first receptivity.
units.note: «على السواء» modifies manifestation and its nonmanifestation under the first qualification, not a division of the Essence.

units.arabic_exact: فغلب أثر هذا الحديث والمحبّة والميل الذاتي حكم الظهور على اللاظهور وحكم بسبقه عليه ،
units.english_review: But the effect of inward discourse, love and essential inclination caused the judgment of manifestation to prevail over nonmanifestation and to have priority over it.
units.note: Priority here remains ontological/rank-priority, not historical sequence within God.

units.arabic_exact: فتجلّى الذات الأقدس على نفسها بحكم ذلك الأثر والتغليب والسبق وظهر لنفسها في نفسها ، أعني في عين ذلك التعيّن والقابلية الأولية ،
units.english_review: The most holy Essence thus disclosed itself to itself according to that influence and priority, and manifested to itself within itself—that is, precisely within the first determination and receptivity.
units.note: Self-disclosure is stated as «تجلّى الذات الأقدس على نفسها»; reflexive construction central.

units.arabic_exact: فوجدت الذات نفسها بهذا التجلّي الذي هو عين العلم والشهود بحكم مرآته المذكورة التي هي عينه الحاملة له المتضمّنة ذلك الحديث والميل والملاحظة ،
units.english_review: Through that self-disclosure, which is identical with knowing and witnessing, the Essence found itself by virtue of the aforementioned mirror, a mirror identical with it that bears the self-disclosure and contains this discourse, inclination and contemplation.
units.note: «فوجدت الذات نفسها» joins wujūd/recognition and witnessing; mirror not a new divine being.

units.arabic_exact: والتأثير بذلك الحديث في نفسه التي هي عين التجلّي والقابلية الأولية منصبغ بحكم اعتبار معنى هو باطن صفة القول وصفة السمع وصفة البصر وصفة القدرة في سابع رتب أبطن كل واحد منها ، وهي رتبة هذا التعين الأول المذكور ،
units.english_review: The effect of this inward discourse in itself, identical with the first self-disclosure and receptivity, bears a qualification of a meaning that is the inner reality of speech, hearing, sight and power at the seventh inward degree of each—the degree of the first determination.
units.note: Attributes are present here as undifferentiated meanings or considerations, not already independently distinct qualities.

units.arabic_exact: فإن القول عبارة عن نفس منبعث من باطن المتنفّس متضمّن معنى يطلب المتنفّس ظهوره ، فيتعيّن ذلك النفس في مراتب المخارج ،
units.english_review: For speech is a breath issuing from the inwardness of the speaker, bearing a meaning the speaker seeks to manifest. The breath is then determined at successive articulatory outlets.
units.note: «نفس» is breath; avoid an implication of bodily respiration in the unconditioned divine reality.

units.arabic_exact: وكذلك المحبة الأصلية التي هي عين التعين الأول والقابلية متضمّنة معنى الكمال المتعلق بالظهور مقتض للتجلي
units.english_review: Likewise, original love—identical with the first determination and receptivity—contains a meaning of perfection linked to manifestation that requires the first self-disclosure—
units.note: Continues on p26 «الأول الذي هو مثل النفس المتعين ...». The translation remains open at the page boundary.

units.arabic_exact: الأول الذي هو مثل النفس المتعين في التعين الأول المنبعث من باطن الغيب المطلق ،
units.english_review: —the first self-disclosure, like the breath determined at the first determination and proceeding from the inwardness of the undelimited Unseen.
units.note: Continuation of p25; retain double meaning of nafas (breath), no physical divine breathing.

units.arabic_exact: والسمع هو قبول ذلك المعنى ظاهرا أو باطنا ،
units.english_review: 'Hearing' is the reception of that meaning outwardly or inwardly.
units.note: Passive/active distinction remains qualified by rank.

units.arabic_exact: والبصر هو قبول ظهوره بما هو ظاهر من القابل منه
units.english_review: 'Sight' is receptive apprehension of its manifestation through what appears from its recipient.
units.note: Source «بما هو ظاهر من القابل منه» syntax somewhat compressed; the English is provisional.

units.arabic_exact: والقوة تمكن مما يطلب ظهوره ،
units.english_review: Power is the capacity to enable what is sought to appear.
units.note: «القوة» is capacity, not a created instrumental force in the Essence.

units.arabic_exact: وهذا المعنى هو الذي أراد به الشيخ ابن الفارض رحمة اللّه عليه في قصيدته بقوله :
units.english_review: This, according to Farghānī, is the meaning intended by Shaykh Ibn al-Fāriḍ, may God have mercy on him, in the following verses:
units.note: The quotation is from Ibn al-Fāriḍ's poetic text within Farghānī's introduction; the separate lineation requires checking against a reliable poetry edition, but extending into the later verse-by-verse commentary is excluded.

units.arabic_exact: فلفظ وكلي بي لسان محدث * ولحظ وكلي فيّ عين لعبرة وسمع وكلي بالنّدا أسمع النداء * وكلّي فيّ ردّ الرّدى يد قوة معاني صفات ما ورى اللّبس أثبتت * وأسماء ذات ما روى الحسّ بثّت
units.english_review: 'My utterance: wholly I am within myself a tongue that speaks. My gaze: wholly I am an eye for contemplation. My hearing: wholly I hear the call when called. My whole self, warding away destruction, is the hand of power. Meanings of attributes were established beyond the veil of clothing; the names of the Essence disseminated what sense related.' [Provisional verse rendering; Arabic hemistich boundaries and verbal nuances remain to be verified against a separate poetic witness.]
units.note: Three paired hemistichs in the digitized text are grouped into one unit to preserve source verbatim. Interpretation of «ورى اللّبس», «ما روى الحس» is not independently established by a poetic witness.

units.arabic_exact: يعني : أثبتت تلك المعاني في الرتبة الأولى التي هي وراء رتبة لبسها من كونها شؤونا ذاتية بأحكام الكثرة والتميّز
units.english_review: That is: these meanings were established at the first rank, which is beyond the rank of their being clothed, when they were essential affairs without judgments of multiplicity and distinction.
units.note: «شؤون ذاتية» appear as later clearly differentiated attributes by rank, not a temporal emergence of faculties in the Essence.

units.arabic_exact: حتى صارت عين تلك المعاني بحكم أحكام اللّبس بأحكام الكثرة والتميّز صفات متغايرة في الرتبة الثانية بحسبها وحكمها ؛ كصفة السمع والبصر والقدرة وصفة الكلام ونحو ذلك ،
units.english_review: When clothed in judgments of multiplicity and differentiation, these same meanings became distinct attributes in the second rank, in conformity with its ruling, such as hearing, sight, power and speech.
units.note: Plurality under the second rank, not under the absolute first.

units.arabic_exact: بعد أن لم تكن في تلك الرتبة الأولى صفات ، بل اعتبارات غير متميّزة ولا متغايرة فيها بحسبها وحكمها ،
units.english_review: Previously, at the first rank, they were not distinct attributes, but considerations that were neither differentiated nor separate from one another.
units.note: Explicit first-rank ontological caveat.

units.arabic_exact: وهذا اللفظ الذي كل الذات لسان محدث نفسه به ، واللحظ الذي كلّه عين لا حظة به ، ليعبر من الباطن إلى الظاهر ، والسمع الذي كل الذات سامع به حديثه ذلك ، واليد التي كل الذات فاعل بها في ردّها اللاظهور المكنى عنه بالردى بملابسة الخفاء والبطون إلى الظهور والوجود ،
units.english_review: Thus the utterance by which the entire Essence is a tongue inwardly speaking to itself; the gaze in which all of it is the eye that beholds, enabling a passage from inward to outward; the hearing by which all of it hears its own discourse; and the hand by which all of it acts to repel nonappearance, figuratively called destruction because of hiddenness, and to bring about appearance and existence—
units.note: Author's long enumeration is kept as a single syntax-bearing unit without dropping speech, sight, hearing or hand of power.

units.arabic_exact: كل ذلك معاني صفة السمع والبصر والقدرة والكلام الثابتة متميّزة في الرتبة الثانية الألوهية متغايرة ،
units.english_review: all these are meanings of hearing, sight, power and speech, which are established as differentiated attributes in the second rank of divinity.
units.note: Second-rank differentiated meanings.

units.arabic_exact: وهذه المعاني التي هي باطن هذه الصفات كانت غير متغايرة في الرتبة الأولى التي هي سابع أبطنها بالنسبة إلى غاية ظهورها ،
units.english_review: These meanings, being the inward reality of those attributes, are not differentiated at the first rank, the seventh inward degree relative to the extremity of their outward manifestation.
units.note: Do not confuse 'seventh depth' with a sevenfold numerical partition of God's Essence.

units.arabic_exact: فإن غاية ظهورها أن تظهر بصورة اللفظ الجاري على لسان الإنسان ونظره بعينه ، وسماعه بأذنه وعمله بيده المضافة كلّها إلى صورة بدنه .
units.english_review: The furthest outward display is speech from the human tongue, seeing with the eye, hearing with the ear and acting by the hand, all attributed to the bodily form.
units.note: Human bodily analogues belong to the furthest outward mode.

units.arabic_exact: وباطنها الأول : أن تكون هذه الصفات مضافة إلى نفسه ، لكن من حيث لم تتميّز عن نفوس سائر الحيوانات إلا بظاهر العقل المعيشي المقيّد بأمور دنيوية ، بحيث يكون نطقه وسماعه ونظره وفعله مقصودة على ما يتعلق بأمر الدنيا غير متعدّ إلى أمر أخروي هو المقصد منه ؛
units.english_review: **First inward degree:** their attribution to the soul, yet insofar as its distinction from animal souls is only the outward face of an intellect bound to worldly livelihood. Speech, hearing, sight and action are thus devoted to this life, not reaching the affairs of the next life, which are their intended end.
units.note: «باطنها الأول» marks first degree inside the human form; the worldly-only intellect's limit is the hereafter, not the absence of cognition.

units.arabic_exact: كما أخبر اللّه تعالى عن هذا الوصف في قوله عزّ وجلّ : يَعْلَمُونَ ظاهِراً مِنَ الْحَياةِ الدُّنْيا وَهُمْ عَنِ الْآخِرَةِ هُمْ غافِلُونَ ( 7 ) [ الرّوم : الآية 7 ] .
units.english_review: This is the condition described by God in Qurʾān 30:7: 'They know an outward aspect of the life of this world, while they are heedless of the Hereafter.'
units.note: «(7)» is the Qurʾānic verse number, explicitly NOT a modern editor's note. Do not strip it from Arabic. The English reader may cite 30:7.

units.arabic_exact: وباطنها الثاني : ما يضاف إلى نفسه من حيث عقله المنوّر بنور الشرع والإيمان باللّه وكتبه ورسله وبالأمور الأخروية ، فيعبر مما يتعلق بالدنيا إلى ما يتعلق بالآخرة في نطقه وسماعه ونظره وفعله بفهم وعقل صحيح وإيمان قوي .
units.english_review: **Second inward degree:** the faculties pertain to a soul whose intellect is illuminated by revealed law and faith in God, His books, His messengers and the hereafter. Through sound understanding and strong faith its speaking, hearing, seeing and action turn from this world toward the next.
units.note: Author's sevenfold schema, not a universal clinical or legal classification.

units.arabic_exact: وباطنها الثالث : ما يضاف منها إلى روحه الروحانية المجرّدة الثابت تعيّنها وتميّزها في عالم الأرواح واللّوح المحفوظ .
units.english_review: **Third degree:** their attribution to the person's immaterial spiritual spirit, whose determination and distinction are established in the realm of spirits and the Preserved Tablet.
units.note: «الروح الروحانية المجرّدة» implies a distinct immaterial-spiritual level.

units.arabic_exact: وباطنها الرابع : ما يضاف منها إلى الوجود العيني المضاف إلى حقيقة الإنسانية المقيّد بها والمظهر لأحكامها في مراتب الكون روحا ومثالا وحسّا المعنى عن هذا الباطن بقوله : « كنت سمعه وبصره ولسانه ويده » « 1 » .
units.english_review: **Fourth degree:** their attribution to concrete existence associated with the human reality, which determines it and receives its rulings as spirit, image and sensible form. Farghānī alludes to the saying, 'I was his hearing, his sight, his tongue and his hand'.
units.note: Degree-qualified concrete existence; do not assimilate creature and Creator unconditionally. Hadith authenticity not checked by these source comparisons.

units.arabic_exact: وباطنها الخامس : ما يضاف منها إلى قلبه القابل التجلّي الوجود الباطني فيه ، المعني بقوله : « وسعني قلب عبدي » « 2 » .
units.english_review: **Fifth degree:** their attribution to the heart, receptive to inward existential disclosure, as in the saying, 'My servant's heart contains Me'.
units.note: «وسعني قلب عبدي» is cited by Farghānī; its authenticity is not established here.

units.arabic_exact: وباطنها السادس : ما يضاف منها إلى الوجود المطلق الرحمني الجمعي الظاهر في مرتبة البرزخية الثانية بحكم فياضيته التي عمّ كل شيء .
units.english_review: **Sixth degree:** their attribution to the comprehensive, merciful, non-delimited existence manifested at the second intermediate rank through the overflowing effusion that encompasses everything.
units.note: Keep the second intermediary rank distinct from the first determination.

units.arabic_exact: وسابع أبطنها : هي هذه المعاني الكائنة في الرتبة الأولى متوحّدة العين متميّزة الحكم بالنسبة ،
units.english_review: **Seventh degree:** the meanings in the first rank are united in reality, while their determinations can be distinguished relationally.
units.note: «متوحّدة العين متميّزة الحكم بالنسبة» unity in reality versus relative distinction.

units.arabic_exact: وكل واحد من هذه المعاني قولا وسماعا وسمعا وبصرا وقوّة له في كل رتبة من الرتب أثر وحكم بانتفائه عن شخص إنساني في رتبة منها يوجب بكم ذلك الشخص وصممه وعمائه وضعفه في تلك الرتبة ،
units.english_review: Each of these meanings—speech, listening, hearing, vision and power—has a ruling and effect at every degree. Lacking one at a given degree makes the person mute, deaf, blind or weak at that degree.
units.note: Arabic includes both «سماعا» and «سمعا»; preserve the dual auditory terms.

units.arabic_exact: ومن ههنا يفهم معنى قوله تعالى : صُمٌّ بُكْمٌ عُمْيٌ فَهُمْ لا يَرْجِعُونَ ( 18 ) [ البقرة : الآية 18 ] ،
units.english_review: On this basis the words 'Deaf, dumb, blind; they do not return' (Q 2:18) are understood by Farghānī as:
units.note: Farghānī's interpretation of the verse, not the only Qurʾānic interpretation.

units.arabic_exact: أي من الدنيا إلى الآخرة ، ومن بطن أول إلى بطن ثان ،
units.english_review: not returning from the world to the hereafter, or from the first inward degree to the second.
units.note: Otherworldly application is the author's gloss.

units.arabic_exact: فإنهم كانوا سميعين بصيرين متكلّمين في البطن الأول
units.english_review: For at the first degree they could hear, see and speak.
units.note: Outward senses may operate while inward attainment is absent.

units.arabic_exact: والناس في فتح باب هذه الأبطن على درجات :
units.english_review: People differ in the extent to which these inward gates open:
units.note: Hierarchical opening of the faculties.

units.arabic_exact: منهم : من لم ينفتح له باب أصلا ، وهم المجانين والأطفال .
units.english_review: for some none opens, a group in which Farghānī includes children and those he calls mad.
units.note: Historical anthropology should not be presented as a present-day diagnosis.

units.arabic_exact: ومنهم : من انفتح له باب أول لا غير وهو الذي أوتي في الدنيا حسنة ، وما له في الآخرة خلاق .
units.english_review: Others have only the first gate opened: one granted good in this world without a share in the hereafter.
units.note: «خلاق» means a share or portion.

units.arabic_exact: ومنهم : من انفتح له باب ثان وهو من عوام أهل الإسلام والإيمان .
units.english_review: Others have the second gate opened: the ordinary people of Islam and faith.
units.note: The list continues with third gate at the opening of p28.

units.arabic_exact: ومنهم : من انفتح له باب ثالث وهو من خواصّهم .
units.english_review: Some have the third gate opened, namely the elect among them.
units.note: Continuation of the spiritual degree count from p27.

units.arabic_exact: ومنهم : من انفتح له باب رابع ، وهو من أهل بداية مقام الولاية والإحسان .
units.english_review: Some have the fourth gate opened, those beginning the station of friendship with God (*walāya*) and excellence (*iḥsān*).
units.note: «الولاية والإحسان» retains spiritual technical force.

units.arabic_exact: ومنهم : من انفتح له باب خامس ، وهو من المتوسّطين .
units.english_review: Some have the fifth: the people of intermediate stations.
units.note: «المتوسّطين» means intermediate stations.

units.arabic_exact: ومنهم : من انفتح له باب سادس ، وهو من أهل النهايات ، وهم الكمّل والأفراد ،
units.english_review: Some have the sixth: those at the ultimate stations, the perfected and the singular ones.
units.note: Do not flatten «الكمل والأفراد».

units.arabic_exact: ولا تنفتح خوخة من الباب السابع لأحد إلّا لصاحب الإرث المحمدي ،
units.english_review: Not even a narrow aperture (*khawkha*) of the seventh gate is opened to anyone save the bearer of the Muhammadan inheritance.
units.note: «خوخة» specifies even the smallest opening, not unrestricted possession.

units.arabic_exact: فإن البطن السابع مختصّ به صلى اللّه عليه وسلم ،
units.english_review: For the seventh inward rank belongs particularly to him—God bless him and grant him peace [the Prophet].
units.note: The pronoun with ﷺ immediately identifies the Prophet; inheritors are distinguished from the origin of the station.

units.arabic_exact: ثم إن هذا التجلّي الأول من حيث هذا الحديث والإخبار المذكور متضمّن كمالا مضافا إليه وإلى اعتباراته وإحساسا كلّيا جمليّا بذلك الكمال ، وذلك أصل الحياة والحيّ وباطنه ،
units.english_review: The first self-disclosure, with respect to the inward speech and notification mentioned, contains a perfection attributed to itself and its considerations and a universal awareness of that perfection. This is the origin and inward reality of life and the Living.
units.note: The inward discourse is not a created physical sound at the first rank.

units.arabic_exact: ومن حيث الملاحظة متضمّن إحساسا بسريان ذلك الكمال في تفاصيل اعتبارات الواحدية ، وذلك أصل العلم والعالم وباطنه ،
units.english_review: Through contemplation it contains apprehension of how perfection pervades the differentiated considerations of oneness, the origin and inward reality of knowledge and the Knowing.
units.note: Life and knowledge remain distinct considerations at subsequent ranks.

units.arabic_exact: ومن حيث ذلك الميل بالسماع والإصغاء تقتضي اعتبارا هو أصل الإرادة ،
units.english_review: Through the inclination to hearing and attentive listening, it entails the consideration that is the origin of will.
units.note: «إرادة» defined through an original inclination, without implying deficiency in the Essence.

units.arabic_exact: ومن حيث ذلك الأثر الحاصل من ذلك الحديث الوحداني في نفسه حتى ترتّب عليه هذا التجلّي ، والوجدان يتضمّن توجّها خاصّا بصورة التأثير إلى تحقيق الكمال الأسمائي وإزالة موانعه وتحصيل شرائطه بلا مغايرة ،
units.english_review: Through the effect of that unitary inward discourse in itself, whereby self-disclosure and finding (*wijdān*) occur, it contains a particular effective orientation toward realizing the perfection of the names, removing impediments and providing conditions, without otherness.
units.note: «الوجدان» is finding/presence and should not always be rendered existence.

units.arabic_exact: فالحكم التأثيري في ذلك التوجه الخاص هو باطن القدرة وحكم تحقيق تفصيل الكمال ،
units.english_review: The effective judgment of that orientation is the inward reality of power and of actualizing differentiated perfection.
units.note: Efficient capacity is a rank-qualified theological expression.

units.arabic_exact: وتحصيل شرائطه متضمّن حقيقة الجود بإفاضة الوجود على حقيقة كل موجود ، فهي من شرائط تحقيق تفصيل الكمال .
units.english_review: Providing its conditions includes the reality of generosity, the effusion of existence upon the reality of every existent: one of the conditions of differentiated perfection.
units.note: Generosity and «إفاضة» do not imply bodily pouring.

units.arabic_exact: وأمّا حكم برزخية التعيّن الأول المعين لهذه الاعتبارات المذكورة وحكم قابليّته للتجلّي الأول ، فمقتض ومعيّن حقيقة العدل والإقساط المضاف إليه تعيين جميع المراتب ورعاية العدالة في القوابل بين الوجوب والاستحالة ،
units.english_review: The intermediacy of the first determination, which establishes these considerations, and its receptivity to the first self-disclosure determine justice and equitable proportioning. The determination of ranks and just balance of receptivities between necessity and impossibility are assigned to it.
units.note: «الإقساط» and receptivity are qualified by the intermediacy.

units.arabic_exact: فكان سابع أبطن القول والسمع والبصر والقوة التي كل واحد منها من حيث ذلك البطن عين الذات وعين الآخر أصلا منشئا للحياة والحي منها ، والعلم والعالم منه ، والإقساط والمقسط منه
units.english_review: The seventh inward depth of speech, hearing, sight and power—each identical with the Essence and with the others under that depth—is the origin of life and the Living, knowledge and the Knowing, and equitable dealing and the Equitable.
units.note: The names arise as differentiated in a subsequent rank, not as multiple essences.

units.arabic_exact: لكن من حيث تحقّقها في حاق البرزخية الثانية وجهة إجمالها التي من حكمها اشتمال كل واحد منها على الباقي مع أثر خفي من حكم تميّزها ،
units.english_review: But at the core of the second intermediacy and its comprehensive aspect, each includes all the others, with a hidden trace of differentiation.
units.note: Second intermediacy is not first-rank identity.

units.arabic_exact: والكل عين واحد في هذا التعين الأول الذي هو أول مرتبة الذات الأقدس وأول مراتب العلم من حيث إنه عين الذات لا صفة ولا نعت زائد عليها ،
units.english_review: All are a single reality at the first determination, the first rank of the most holy Essence and of knowledge insofar as knowledge is identical with the Essence, not an additional attribute.
units.note: Author explicitly negates an added quality.

units.arabic_exact: وعبّر عنه بعض الأكابر من حيث البرزخية المذكورة بحقيقة الحقائق لكليّته وكونه أصلا لكل اعتبار
units.english_review: Some great masters call this first intermediacy 'the Reality of Realities' (*ḥaqīqat al-ḥaqāʾiq*), owing to its universality and its being the source of every consideration—
units.note: Ends mid-sentence at p28; p29 begins «وتعيّن وباطن كل حقيقة...». No invented closure.
